Desirable: Ph.D. or equivalent in relevant discipline.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Jamshedpur Guest Faculty/ Coach Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty / Coach post at NIT Jamshedpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 24-08-2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty / Coach position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty / Coach position is Rs. 2,000/- per class. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for the Guest Faculty / Coach post?
faq.answer: Essential qualifications include a Master's Degree in Physical Education or equivalent for Physical Education & Sports, a Master's Degree in Yoga or equivalent for Yoga, a Postgraduate Degree or ex-serviceman with NCC 'C' Certificate for NCC, and a Postgraduate with NSS Certificate for NSS.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty / Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-In-Interview. Candidates are required to attend the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the Walk-In-Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-In-Interview will be held at NIT Jamshedpur. Specific details regarding the venue will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty / Coach post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Faculty / Coach positions announced by NIT Jamshedpur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention an age limit. Candidates are advised to check the detailed advertisement for any specific age criteria or relaxation rules.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be attached with the application email?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
